notes.title: Implemented new NPC systems for the single player adventure mode
notes.notes:
**Implemented new NPC systems for the single player adventure mode to not just run down the players**
-Updated some parry collision bugs
-Updated spawning to try and prevent falling through the floor

notes.title: early, and buggy, proof of concept of roguelike mode available
notes.notes:
I started working on the roguelike mode, "Adventure"! It's still very early and has many unfinished pieces in the current build, so there will be some bugs and crashes in this mode and bash related to items, so let me know if you run into any and wat to help fixing
Removed the April fools patch
Fixed bugs related to parry hit detection
Fixed bugs related to projectile hit detection not ignoring owning character

notes.title: HOT DOGS OF DUALITY
notes.notes:
** NEW CHARACTER - THE HOT DOG OF THE THIRD GOD
is a big hot dog! This character has a limited moveset like NPCs

** New menu sounds!
a man screams at you when you open the game!
also other sounds and visual clarity for the main menu and character select screen was added

** Play as NPCS - Limited time event
NPCs from the Bash mode are playable for this patch! These characters have a limited moveset

** Small quality of life adjustments
Balanced some characters, updated the damage number positioning, updated tutorial text

** Also added stages since initial release, but that was in the previous patch

notes.title: Fixed issues with tutorial and credits
notes.notes:
Thanks you for playing my first game and helping me find and fix issues with it!
Fixed default controls to be accurate for tutorial
Added leave button when finishing tutorial
Fixed credits having some names being cut off
Added leave button when killing all enemies in solo bash
